description: This is a FastAPI router module 'bookings.py' that manages booking and cancellation endpoints for classes, incorporating capacity enforcement and user permissions. It defines request models, internal utility functions, and route handlers for creating and canceling bookings, including checks for capacity, user roles, and existing bookings.

classes.name: BookingCreateRequest
classes.description: Data model for creating a booking, including class ID and optional member ID (used by admins to book for others).

classes.name: BookingCancelRequest
classes.description: Data model for canceling a booking, including class ID.

methods.name: int _get_booked_count(db: Session, class_id: int)
methods.description: Counts the number of current 'booked' bookings for a given class to enforce capacity limits.

methods.name: Classes _ensure_class_exists(db: Session, class_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches class details by ID and raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: dict create_booking( payload: BookingCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a booking for a class, with capacity and duplication checks, considering user permissions.

methods.name: dict cancel_booking( payload: BookingCancelRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to cancel a user's booking, with admin override allowing cancellation of other users' bookings.
